text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and try to limit junk food. Second, regular exercise, such as walking or cycling, keeps your body strong and helps you feel happier. Sleep is also important, so aim for about eight hours every night. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends and family when you feel stressed, and make time to relax. Finally, a good work-life balance helps you avoid burnout, so plan your day carefully and enjoy your free time. Small daily habits like these can make a big difference to your health.
